text: The roles are dealt. Look at yours, and let nobody look over your shoulder.
when: The roles are dealt.

text: Each of you now holds a secret. Look at it. Alone.
when: The roles are dealt.

text: The cards are shuffled. Only your phone knows who you are. Keep it that way.
when: The roles are dealt.

text: The first night falls over the village. Everyone close your eyes.
direction: Slow, hushed, the village goes to sleep.
when: The first night falls, classic night.

text: Darkness comes to the village. The lights go out, one by one. Close your eyes.
direction: Slow, hushed, the village goes to sleep.
when: The first night falls, classic night.

text: The sun has set. For the first time the village sleeps with a werewolf among it. Eyes closed.
direction: Slow, hushed, the village goes to sleep.
when: The first night falls, classic night.

text: Night returns. Everyone close your eyes.
when: A later night falls, classic night.

text: Darkness again. The village has grown smaller. Close your eyes.
when: A later night falls, classic night.

text: Another night. Who makes it through, you will learn in the morning. Eyes closed.
when: A later night falls, classic night.

text: Night falls over the village. Nobody trusts their neighbour any more. Close your eyes.
when: A later night falls, classic night.

text: Night falls over the village. Everyone close your eyes … and tap on your phone.
when: A night falls in Whowolf's night (everyone taps).

text: Night comes. Now everyone taps, and nobody gives themselves away.
when: A night falls in Whowolf's night (everyone taps).

text: Darkness. Everyone has something to do, and from the outside it all looks the same.
when: A night falls in Whowolf's night (everyone taps).

text: Cupid wakes up and binds two people in love.
when: Classic night, first night: cupid is called.

text: Cupid opens his eyes. From tonight, two hearts shall beat as one.
when: Classic night, first night: cupid is called.

text: The werewolves wake up and choose a victim.
direction: Low and close, a touch of menace.
when: Classic night: the werewolves are called.

text: The werewolves open their eyes. They are hungry.
direction: Low and close, a touch of menace.
when: Classic night: the werewolves are called.

text: Now the werewolves wake. Silently they agree on a victim.
direction: Low and close, a touch of menace.
when: Classic night: the werewolves are called.

text: The werewolves are awake. Whom will they take tonight?
direction: Low and close, a touch of menace.
when: Classic night: the werewolves are called.

text: The seer wakes up and looks into someone's soul.
when: Classic night: the seer is called.

text: The seer opens her eyes. Whose secret will she see tonight?
when: Classic night: the seer is called.

text: The seer is awake. One look, and she knows who someone really is.
when: Classic night: the seer is called.

text: The witch wakes up. She sees who is to die tonight and reaches for her potions.
when: Classic night: the witch is called.

text: The witch opens her eyes. One healing potion, one poison. What will she brew tonight?
when: Classic night: the witch is called.

text: The witch is awake. She knows whom the werewolves chose. Will she save them?
when: Classic night: the witch is called.

text: Eyes closed again.
when: Classic night: a role goes back to sleep (before the next is called).

text: Back to sleep.
when: Classic night: a role goes back to sleep (before the next is called).

text: Eyes closed.
when: Classic night: a role goes back to sleep (before the next is called).

text: The sun rises over the village. The first night is over.
direction: Brighter, but with a shadow over it.
when: The first morning.

text: The rooster crows. The village wakes after its first night.
direction: Brighter, but with a shadow over it.
when: The first morning.

text: The sun rises over the village.
when: A later morning.

text: Day breaks. The village counts who is still there.
when: A later morning.

text: A new morning. Not everyone lived to see it.
when: A later morning.

text: Tonight, someone did not make it.
when: In the morning: one player died (the screen shows who; the narrator walks to their seat).

text: One of you did not wake up.
when: In the morning: one player died (the screen shows who; the narrator walks to their seat).

text: The village has lost one of its own.
when: In the morning: one player died (the screen shows who; the narrator walks to their seat).

text: One seat at the table stays empty today.
when: In the morning: one player died (the screen shows who; the narrator walks to their seat).

text: Tonight, two did not make it.
when: In the morning: two players died.

text: Two of you did not wake up. That was a dark night.
when: In the morning: two players died.

text: The village mourns twice today.
when: In the morning: two players died.

text: Everyone woke up again. Nobody died.
when: In the morning: nobody died.

text: A miracle: nobody died tonight.
when: In the morning: nobody died.

text: Everyone is still here. Did someone have a hand in that?
when: In the morning: nobody died.

text: The role was: villager.
when: After a death, when roles are revealed.

text: It was a simple villager.
when: After a death, when roles are revealed.

text: The role was: werewolf.
when: After a death, when roles are revealed: a werewolf.

text: It was a werewolf!
when: After a death, when roles are revealed: a werewolf.

text: The role was: seer.
when: After a death, when roles are revealed.

text: It was the seer. What might she have seen?
when: After a death, when roles are revealed.

text: The role was: witch.
when: After a death, when roles are revealed.

text: It was the witch. Her potions stay on the shelf.
when: After a death, when roles are revealed.

text: The role was: hunter.
when: After a death, when roles are revealed.

text: It was the hunter.
when: After a death, when roles are revealed.

text: The role was: cupid.
when: After a death, when roles are revealed.

text: It was cupid.
when: After a death, when roles are revealed.

text: Now talk: who is the werewolf?
when: The day's discussion begins.

text: The floor is yours. Who was it?
when: The day's discussion begins.

text: Look at each other closely. One of you is lying.
when: The day's discussion begins.

text: Now you talk. And remember: the werewolf talks too.
when: The day's discussion begins.

text: Enough talk. Vote now.
when: The vote begins.

text: Time to decide. Who has to go?
when: The vote begins.

text: Cast your votes. In secret, on your phone.
when: The vote begins.

text: The village has decided.
when: The vote has a result (the narrator walks to that seat).

text: The votes are counted. The village has spoken.
when: The vote has a result (the narrator walks to that seat).

text: So be it.
when: The vote has a result (the narrator walks to that seat).

text: Nobody was banished.
when: The vote ends in a tie or nobody voted.

text: The village cannot agree. Nobody has to go.
when: The vote ends in a tie or nobody voted.

text: A tie. Today everything stays as it is.
when: The vote ends in a tie or nobody voted.

text: The hunter has fallen and takes aim …
when: The hunter has died and takes aim (the narrator walks to the hunter).

text: The hunter raises his bow one last time …
when: The hunter has died and takes aim (the narrator walks to the hunter).

text: The hunter lowers his bow.
when: The hunter decides not to shoot.

text: The hunter spares everyone. His arrow stays in the quiver.
when: The hunter decides not to shoot.

text: Out of grief, the beloved follows into death.
when: A lover dies of grief.

text: Without the other, the beloved will not go on.
when: A lover dies of grief.

text: The village has won. The werewolves are defeated.
when: The village wins.

text: The last werewolf has fallen. The village can sleep in peace again.
when: The village wins.

text: Done it! The village has found its werewolves.
when: The village wins.

text: The werewolves have won. The village has fallen silent.
when: The werewolves win.

text: The werewolves are among themselves. The village is theirs.
when: The werewolves win.

text: Too late. The werewolves have won.
when: The werewolves win.

text: The lovers have won. In the end, only love counts.
when: The lovers win.

text: Only the two of them are left. Love has won.
when: The lovers win.
